description: Remove Supabase and Google OAuth completely from the codebase - delete files, remove dependencies, clean up imports and references
steps: Step 1: Delete `apps/frontend/src/lib/supabase.js` - this is the Supabase client initialization file
Step 2: Delete `apps/frontend/src/components/GoogleSignInButton.jsx` - Google OAuth button component
Step 4: Delete `apps/frontend/src/components/GoogleOAuthCallbackEffect.test.jsx` - test for deleted component
Step 5: Delete `apps/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.googleOAuth.test.jsx` - test for Google OAuth flow in AuthContext
Step 7: In `apps/frontend/src/App.jsx`, remove the import of GoogleOAuthCallbackEffect (line 9) and remove `<GoogleOAuthCallbackEffect />` from the JSX (line 275)

Step 8: In `apps/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.jsx`: (a) Remove `import GoogleSignInButton from '@/components/GoogleSignInButton'` (line 11), (b) Remove the entire `<div className="mb-5">` block that contains the GoogleSignInButton and the 'or continue with email' divider (lines ~175-183)

Step 9: In `apps/frontend/src/pages/SignupPage.jsx`: (a) Remove `import GoogleSignInButton from '@/components/GoogleSignInButton'` (line 11), (b) Remove the entire `<div className="mb-5">` block that contains the GoogleSignInButton, the Terms/Privacy text about Google, and the 'or sign up with email' divider (the block between the error display and the form)

Step 10: In `apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py`: (a) Remove the `GoogleAuthRequest` model class, (b) Remove the entire `@router.post('/google', ...)` endpoint function (google_auth), (c) Remove the `import httpx` that's only used inside that function
Step 11: In `apps/backend/app/config.py`: Remove the `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY` fields from the Settings class (lines in the '# --- P10: Supabase (OAuth) ---' section)
Step 12: In `.github/workflows/deploy-all.yml`: Remove the `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` env vars from the frontend build step (lines 176-177)
Step 13: In `.github/workflows/pr-lockfile-refresh.yml`: Remove the `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` env vars from the frontend build step (lines 56-57)
Step 14: Run `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` in the workspace root to update the lockfile after removing the supabase dependency
acceptance_criteria: No file named supabase.js exists in apps/frontend/src/lib/
No file named GoogleSignInButton.jsx exists in apps/frontend/src/components/
No file named GoogleOAuthCallbackEffect.jsx or its test exists in apps/frontend/src/components/
No import of GoogleSignInButton or GoogleOAuthCallbackEffect in any source file
No SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY in backend config.py
No VITE_SUPABASE_URL or VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in any CI workflow file
The /google endpoint no longer exists in auth.py
verification: grep -r 'supabase' apps/frontend/src/ --include='*.jsx' --include='*.js' should return no results (excluding node_modules)
grep -r 'GoogleSignInButton\|GoogleOAuthCallbackEffect' apps/frontend/src/ --include='*.jsx' should return no results
grep -r 'SUPABASE' apps/backend/app/ --include='*.py' should return no results
findings: Build failure (PostCSS/Tailwind config) is pre-existing on base branch, not caused by this change. Frontend tests: 65/68 test files pass; 3 pre-existing failures due to missing import paths (edge-proxy, functions/_middleware). Test files for LoginPage, SignupPage, AuthPage.turnstile, LoginPage.aria, LoginPage.axe all pass (69 tests). vi.mock calls for GoogleSignInButton in test files are dead code but harmless - left as-is since they belong to unmodified test files.
